item.title: Cisco open sources tool for detecting AI agents on hacking sprees
item.description: Cisco has open sourced a behavior detection engine that watches AI agents, to help security teams prevent rogue agents from going off the rails like they did with the Hugging Face hack – or worse. It’s called Project Quarry, and it aims to provide a “shared language” for evaluating agent behavior, along the lines of what Snort , which Cisco also maintains, did for detecting malicious network traffic and what YARA did for rule-based malware identification. Most detection tools rely on specific interactions with an AI model or agent. Did it attempt prompt injection? Or did the agent call an attack tool? “But what is missing is the entire context under which something may occur,” Amy Chang, head of AI threat and security research at Cisco, said in an exclusive interview with The Register . She likened this to credit card fraud detection. Without context, individual transactions such as a small test charge or a single purchase in a location far away from a card-holder's usual location may not raise any flags. “And then you try again,” making another fraudulent purchase, “and that went through, too. So now I’m gonna buy the PS5,” Chang said. “Those are the things that Quarry addresses by taking into consideration the entire agent session,” she explained. “One tool call may seem in-scope until you realize that that next step is taking that information and sending it to an attacker-controlled inbox or server.” Even data theft is a sequence and not a single agentic action. Agentic AI security firm Invariant Labs demonstrated this with a proof-of-concept attack against GitHub's MCP server that hijacked a user's agent via a malicious GitHub Issue, and coerced it into leaking data from private repositories. Simply reading a configuration file, or sending a request to an external endpoint may be legitimate agentic actions. However, combining the two can lead to data exfiltration – and shows “why action relationships matter,” wrote Chang and fellow Cisco researchers Adam Swanda, Ravikumar Balakrishnan, and Konstantin Berlin in a blog post about Quarry shared with The Register ahead of publication “A policy can produce a finding when the trace shows a sensitive file read followed within a defined window by an external send,” they wrote. “The risk comes from the relationship between the two actions, so the finding should preserve evidence from both." Quarry covers single- and multi-turn large language model conversations, agents, tool use, Model Context Protocol (MCP) interactions, and multimodal inputs. In addition to the open source code itself, the project’s GitHub repository includes installation instructions, supported Python versions, plugins for Claude Code, Codex and other MCP-compatible agents, configuration examples, rule-writing guidance, and a rule starter pack. For instance, with the rule pack, “If a base-64 encoded malware is somewhere in the tool call, that would result in a block,” Chang said. The rule format looks similar to a YARA or Snort rul

item.title: 4 key matchups to watch in Bengals vs. Titans
item.description: The Cincinnati Bengals improved to 4-2 on the season with a second-half surge against the Baltimore Ravens. The Tennessee Titans fell to 1-6 after a tough 27-24 loss to the Cleveland Browns. On paper, the Cincinnati Bengals should handily beat the Titans. Games are not played on paper, though, and just about any NFL team could have success vs. the Bengals if they play like they did in the first half of the Baltimore game. Now, let’s take a look at some of the key matchups this week. Jeffery Simmons vs. Dalton Risner and Ted Karras Jeffery Simmons is still one of the best pass-rushing defensive tackles in the NFL. He has 24 pressures and four sacks already this season for the Titans. Ted Karras and Simmons have some history, with Karras infamous for up yours Tennessee a few years back after getting into a scuffle with Simmons late in the game. Dalton Risner will see a lot of Simmons this week also. I thought Risner played his worst game of the season against Baltimore. It seems like his knee injury is still hampering his play on the field. A fully healthy Dalton Risner would have his hands full with Simmons, so we shall see if one that continues to play through injury can keep him from wrecking the game on the interior. Jermaine Johnson vs. Amarius Mims Jermaine Johnson was traded to the Titans from the New York Jets this offseason. He currently has 21 pressures and three sacks this season. He will be matched up against one of the best offensive tackles in the league, Amarius Mims, this week. Mims has allowed just four pressures the entire season. That is an absurd number through six games of the season in the NFL. While I don’t want to discredit Johnson here, I will just tell him good luck when matched up against Mims. Mims should be an All-Pro this season, and it is a shame that he doesn’t get more national recognition for his play this year. Amarius Mims vs. Miami Dolphins Mims has allowed 4 pressures according to PFF on 209 pass blocking snaps. The only players with less are Garrett Bolles with 3 pressures on 188 PBLK snaps, Jermaine Eluemenor with 3 pressures on 161 PBLK snaps, and Joe Alt with 3 pressures on just… pic.twitter.com/KeUtdiB0XB — Bengals & Brews (@BengalsBrews) October 13, 2026 Tony Pollard vs. Demetrius Knight Jr. and Barrett Carter Tony Pollard had his best game of the season last week against Cleveland. Pollard rushed for 129 yards and three rushing touchdowns. He added 3 receptions for another 26 yards during the game. While Tennessee has struggled as a whole offensively, Pollard is one player that could give the Bengals’ defense some trouble this week. If they are going to contain Pollard, some of that responsibility will go to the second-year linebackers in Knight and Carter. Both guys have improved overall this season, but missed tackles can still be an issue at times. Carter has a 13.8% missed tackle rate on the season. Knight has a 10.7% missed tackle rate. item.title: The hypocrisy of Mikel Arteta’s scathing reaction towards ‘kid’ Max Dowman
item.description: They don’t call them the troubled teens for no reason. Max Dowman is 16 years of age (not sure anybody’s mentioned that before). Arsenal ’s child prodigy is one of football’s most exciting talents, though as someone who cannot yet legally drive, he is still some way off reaching full maturity. His straight red card against Fleetwood , born from the short fuse not uncommon in those his age, was a clear indication of that. His outburst was hardly unprovoked; Fleetwood midfielder Harrison Neal had just lunged in with a scissoring challenge, the type that has broken legs before. But that isn’t an excuse to lose your head, not at this level. Neither is his age, which on the pitch is a non-factor; he has been entrusted to play senior football so is expected to carry himself like a senior footballer. Max Dowman was sent off for violent conduct against Fleetwood (Reuters) Dowman’s kick-out, even if soft, was a major blunder on his end. He is now suspended for three games - barring a successful appeal - and will not get an opportunity for redemption until the visit of Manchester City on 29 November. That’s over a month of unavailability. He should receive a dressing down from his manager to drive home the lesson that needs to be learned, especially in the context of his sending off for the England U19s at the beginning of the month. There is a pattern emerging of ill-discipline that Arsenal need to nip in the bud. However, there’s a good way of dealing with these things and a bad way, especially when the player in question is not yet an adult. Mikel Arteta went for the latter when he appeared direct a furious reaction towards Dowman from the touchline as he walked down the tunnel, for all the world to see. This has now become the story, arguably more than his red card. To reiterate, Arteta had every right to be angry at his player. The sending off was stupid, petulant and completely avoidable, putting Arsenal at a man disadvantage for the final five minutes, during which they could have found a late winner and avoided the perils of penalties. It lit the blue-touch paper for Arsenal’s humiliating Carabao Cup exit that would be sealed 21 minutes later. But to put him on blast so publicly rather than wait until they’ve got the privacy of the dressing room felt irresponsible. Dowman is in an especially unique position as a player who burst onto the scene at the very top level aged just 15. Arteta himself has repeatedly stated how careful the club have to be in nurturing him to his full potential. After becoming the Premier League’s youngest ever scorer with his goal against Everton in March, Arteta was keen to ensure the noise surrounding Dowman didn’t become overwhelming, even telling the media: “I need your help with that, guys.” You haven’t helped yourself here, Mikel. item.title: Bills pass rush gets a golden opportunity against battered Ravens line
item.description: ORCHARD PARK - Whether or not star quarterback Lamar Jackson is back in time to face the Buffalo Bills Sunday at Highmark Stadium , one of the biggest keys for the Baltimore Ravens will be the performance of its injury-ravaged offensive line. Obviously, getting Jackson on the field gives the line a better chance to look good because he’s such a dynamic player both as a passer and runner, similar to Josh Allen in that he can turn a potential sack into a 30-yard scramble or completion. Still, the Bills’ defensive front has to take advantage of Baltimore’s blockers who have already used 16 different five-man combinations in the first seven games, plus lost brutish blocking tight end Durham Smythe for the season. With their line struggling to find consistency amid all the turnover, the Ravens’ offense has been haphazard. Sure, they topped 30 points three times, but those games came against the defenses of the Falcons, Cowboys and Colts that currently rank 20th, 23rd and 24th, respectively, in points allowed per game. They managed a mundane 24 points (with Jackson) in a win over the lowly Titans, and in the other three games, losses to the Saints (with Jackson), Browns and Bengals (without Jackson), they’ve scored a total of just 40 points. “It’s like, what are we asking some of these younger guys to do? Can they do it? Can we be good at the things that we’re asking them to do?” Ravens coach Jesse Minter said of the offensive line. “We’ve certainly had a little bit of flux on the O-line, but that’s not an excuse to say that we shouldn’t be able to move the ball with who we have.” How Ravens offensive line injuries have hurt Baltimore's offense Who they have, of course, is maybe Jackson, running back Derrick Henry, and wide receiver Zay Flowers, three of the best players at their positions in the NFL. But when your line is struggling to protect and create gaps in the run game, an offense can get bogged down. Things only got trickier in the 35-13 loss to Cincinnati last week when the line suffered another setback as rookie first-round pick Vega Ioane hurt his knee and is likely out against Buffalo. Veteran center Cam Jurgens, who was acquired in a trade from the Eagles, made his Ravens’ debut against the Bengals and was average while RT Roger Rosengarten and LG John Simpson both had rough games. “Sure, but that’s no excuse,” LT Ronnie Stanley said of the injuries. “We have a lot of players hurt; they have players hurt. That’s happened throughout the league. We still have enough to get the job done, and that’s what we expect from our players.” Through seven games, even though both Jackson and backup QB Tyler Huntley are mobile and can escape pressure, the Ravens’ sack percentage against of 8.2% is seventh-worst. And in the last two games, Henry has rushed for only 103 yards and 3.02 yards per carry. Can the Bills pass rush exploit the Ravens' offensive line? Dirk Kuyt takes interim charge of Fenerbahce ahead of Liverpool reunion
item.description: Dirk Kuyt takes interim charge of Fenerbahce ahead of Liverpool reunion Dirk Kuyt has been placed in interim charge of Fenerbahce , setting up a touchline reunion with Liverpool when the Reds visit Turkiye in the Champions League next week. The Dutchman steps up after Ismail Kartal resigned as head coach earlier this week. Kuyt had joined Kartal's staff as assistant manager during the summer. Kartal stepped down after defeat to arch-rivals Galatasaray on Monday night left Fenerbahce fifth in the table. Fenerbahce have not named a permanent successor. The club said Kuyt will lead the team "until a new head coach is appointed". The 46-year-old is a popular figure at Fenerbahce, where he scored 37 goals in 130 games, winning the Süper Lig title in 2014. A familiar face for Liverpool Kuyt had signed for Fenerbahce from Liverpool after six seasons at Anfield, between 2006 and 2012. He scored 71 goals in 285 appearances for the Reds. After retiring from football in 2017, Kuyt has stepped into coaching. He's had senior roles with ADO Den Haag, Beerschot and FC Dordrecht before returning to Fenerbahce as assistant in the summer. Unless a permanent appointment is made prior, Kuyt will be in the opposition dugout when Liverpool face Fenerbahce on Wednesday, November 4, in their fourth match of the Champions League league phase. Liverpool have a perfect record after three games, while Fenerbahce are winless. The Turkish side have drawn twice and lost once.

item.title: NC State & Baylor should make high-profile coaching hires
item.description: Over the last decade, thanks to the transfer portal and NIL money, college football has become a sport with its own economy. Money drives everything in college football. The goal is to spend as much money as possible on the roster so it has the most talent. This shift has also changed how head coaches are viewed, because would you rather spend money on a good head coach or on players? It becomes a bit of a “chicken or the egg” situation. If you pay a good head coach, he may be able to bring in better players and get the most out of them. Or, you can cut out the middleman and just pay for good players. This also changes the economy around firing head coaches. MORE: Biggest risers in College Football after Week 8 Massive contract buyouts The ACC Huddle pregame show kicks off on the campus of Florida State University and features former FSU head coach Jimbo Fisher. Several fans in the background hold signs reading “bring back Jimbo” and “some legends hit different.” Credit: USA TODAY Network via Reuters Connect (Reuters) We’ve seen some head coaches with massive contract buyouts (Brian Kelly and Jimbo Fisher, to name a few), but we’ve also seen schools hesitate to fire head coaches because of them. Because if you have to pay $20 million to buy out a head coach, you would get more return on your money to just invest that $20 million on the roster. Well, in the last week, NC State and Baylor got tired of waiting. NC State fired head coach Dave Doeren in his 14th season on the job, and owes him in the neighborhood of $10 million in a buyout. Dave Aranda won a Big 12 Championship at Baylor, but that goodwill ran out as he was just fired and is reportedly owed $12 million. Both schools now have a job opening for head coach, and both are rumored to have interesting plans to fill them. NC State could make a bold move Jan 20, 2024; Baltimore, MD, USA; ESPN college football and NFL analyst Robert Griffin III reacts on the sidelines before a 2024 AFC divisional round game between the Houston Texans and the Baltimore Ravens at M&T Bank Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Tommy Gilligan-USA TODAY Sports Credit: USA TODAY Sports via Reuters Connect (Reuters) NC State is reportedly seriously considering hiring Philip Rivers as their next head coach. Yes, that Philip Rivers, the NC State legend who recently returned from retirement to play for the Indianapolis Colts last season. Baylor’s Athletic Director has met with Robert Griffin III, aka RG3, about the position. Yes, the RG3 that won the Heisman, and our hearts, back in 2011, before flaming out in the NFL and becoming a broadcaster. Neither of these men has coached a snap of college football before. Only Rivers has experience at the high school level, as a head coach at St. Michael Catholic. Why would either of these established programs take a chance on such inexperienced and under-qualified candidates? The answer is money. First, these two men are already financially well-off. item.title: Former Netherlands winger Kuyt appointed Fenerbahçe interim coach
item.description: FILE PHOTO - Former Liverpool legend Dirk Kuyt warms up ahead of the friendly soccer match between Liverpool Legends and Celtic Legends the Anfield. (is associated with: «Former Netherlands winger Kuyt appointed Fenerbahçe interim coach») Ian Hodgson/PA Wire/dpa Former Netherlands winger Dirk Kuyt will take over as Fenerbahçe interim coach after the resignation of Ismail Kartal, the Turkish club said on X on Wednesday. Kartal resigned on Tuesday, less than 24 hours after the Istanbul derby defeat against Galatasaray. Kuyt first task will be a league match against Göztepe on Saturday. If he's still in charge after that, he will face his former club Liverpool in the Champions League next Wednesday. Kuyt was a fan favourite at Liverpool and played for Fenerbahçe for three years between 2012 and 2015, but he doesn't have a lot of coaching experience.

item.title: Michael Carrick and Bruno Fernandes take major step in bid to salvage Man United crisis
item.description: Michael Carrick and Bruno Fernandes have held clear-the-air talks as the Manchester United manager and captain try to rebuild their relationship. Fernandes was critical of Carrick’s tactics, and the team’s lack of pressing, in United’s 4-1 defeat to Como last week . And four days later the reigning PFA Player of the Year was dropped from the team and left unused as a substitute during the 3-0 loss to Bournemouth, with Carrick describing his omission as a “pure football” decision. Michael Carrick and Bruno Fernandes have held clear-the-air talks (PA Archive) But whereas Sunday seemed to signal the end of Carrick’s reign, United instead decided against sacking the 45-year-old and he will be in charge for Saturday’s trip to Chelsea . He and Fernandes spoke at United’s Carrington training ground on Tuesday in a conversation which could pave the way for the Portugal international to return to the team. Fernandes is deemed to have been back to the best version of himself in the last couple of days after a tough two weeks. But he has failed to find form this season and has not scored in his last seven appearances, while his only Premier League goals came in August, when he scored a hat-trick against Ipswich. Carrick preferred to pick summer signing Youri Tielemans and Mason Mount instead of Fernandes for the Bournemouth game.

item.title: Thierry Henry clarifies his Lamine Yamal comments after Ballon d’Or criticism
item.description: Spain and Barcelona forward Lamine Yamal speaks after winning the Trophy for the Men's Young Talent of the Year during the 2026 Ballon d'Or France Football award ceremony at the Palladium Theatre in London on October 26, 2026. (Photo by FRANCK FIFE / AFP via Getty Images) | AFP via Getty Images Thierry Henry has clarified his comments after coming in for some criticism for a question directed at Lamine Yamal during Monday’s Ballon d’Or ceremony. Yamal picked up the Kopa Trophy for the third time , with Henry asking the teenager: “That’s your third one, right? But is it the one that you really wanted tonight?” The comments did not go down well with some people and Henry has now responded in a post on social media. “I want to clarify some stuff as some people got really excited for actually nothing. With Lamine Yamal, it wasn’t about checking his ego at all. I simply thought that, since it was the third time he had won that trophy, I was just asking him if it was the one he truly wanted,” he said. “We all knew what he wanted. Unfortunately, he didn’t get it. I’m a big fan of Lamine Yamal. I wasn’t checking his ego at all. If you don’t like the joke, I can understand that. But please, don’t do that; he really is one of those players I will pay to watch—I love him. “I was just asking him if it was the one he really wants, because I knew the real prize was coming after —which, unfortunately, he didn’t win. He’s a hell of a player; I love watching him, and I would pay to see him play.”

item.title: Barcelona dressing room remains united despite back-to-back defeats to PSG and Madrid
item.description: Barcelona dressing room remains united despite back-to-back defeats to PSG and Madrid Barcelona’s senior players have organised a team barbecue at the Ciutat Esportiva Joan Gamper in an effort to reinforce squad unity following consecutive defeats to Paris Saint-Germain and Real Madrid, according to SPORT . The initiative comes at a difficult moment for Hansi Flick’s side, but the report indicates that the recent results have not damaged relationships within the dressing room. The Catalan club has lost two major fixtures in quick succession , leaving the players frustrated with their performances. Nevertheless, the squad remains united and recognises the need to improve on the pitch as Barcelona look to regain momentum in the coming matches. Barcelona captains organise barbecue to strengthen unity The team gathering is scheduled for Wednesday after training and a commercial photo shoot involving several players. Barcelona dressing room is united despite back-to-back defeats. (Photo by David Ramos/Getty Images) The squad will then share a barbecue at the club’s training complex, giving teammates an opportunity to spend time together away from their usual footballing responsibilities. The decision to hold the event at the Ciutat Esportiva Joan Gamper also offers greater privacy. Previous team lunches at restaurants around Barcelona have attracted journalists and curious onlookers, prompting the players to choose a more discreet setting for this occasion. Now, with fixture congestion to look forward to and pressure mounting after the recent losses, maintaining strong relationships within the squad remains an important part of the team’s response. Barcelona dressing room remains positive Barcelona captains have organised a team gathering. (Photo by Alex Caparros/Getty Images) The defeats have undoubtedly disappointed the players, particularly because they came against two major opponents within the space of a week. Barcelona’s performances have exposed areas that require improvement , and the squad understands the importance of returning to winning ways. However, there are no internal problems coming from the results. The relationships between teammates remain strong, while the players continue to trust the work being carried out under Flick. Simply put, frustration over results does not necessarily indicate divisions within a dressing room, and the atmosphere suggests Barcelona’s players are treating the setbacks as a collective responsibility.

item.title: Kobbie Mainoo returns to Man United training ahead of Chelsea clash
item.description: Kobbie Mainoo returns to Man United training ahead of Chelsea clash Kobbie Mainoo is said to have returned to Manchester United training after a four-match absence, putting the midfielder in contention for Saturday’s trip to Chelsea. Mainoo’s injury timeline Mainoo completed United’s 1-1 draw with Tottenham Hotspur on 10 October but sustained an issue during the match. The injury then ruled him out of the Champions League defeat at Atletico Madrid three days later. Head coach Michael Carrick was unsure whether the midfielder would recover for the meeting with Leeds United, which Mainoo subsequently missed. Carrick then estimated on 20 October that the academy graduate could require another 10 days (via RotoWire ). Mainoo remained unavailable for the matches against Como and Bournemouth. Wednesday return gives Carrick a Chelsea selection option Mainoo’s return was confirmed in an update which stated: “The midfielder took part in Wednesday morning’s session at Carrington after missing United’s last four matches through injury” (via Sam C ). Mainoo’s reaction to the session is likely to influence whether he starts, makes the bench or is held back at Stamford Bridge. The timing could prove useful for Carrick, who will remain in charge against Chelsea despite United sitting 16th in the Premier League. His side have won only twice in 12 matches across all competitions this season. Carrick began the campaign with Youri Tielemans and Andrey Santos as his central pairing before Mainoo replaced Santos. Carlos Baleba has also recently returned to full fitness following an ankle injury, giving the coach more scope to adjust a midfield which has struggled to provide enough creativity and drive. From United’s academy to an FA Cup final goal Mainoo played for Cheadle & Gatley before joining Manchester United’s academy in 2014 at the age of nine. No transfer fee was involved. He made his senior debut against Charlton Athletic in the League Cup on 10 January 2023. Before his latest injury absence, he had accumulated 110 competitive appearances for the Red Devils and scored eight goals. The midfielder won the FA Youth Cup in 2022 and lifted the senior FA Cup two years later. Mainoo scored United’s second goal in the 2-1 final victory over Manchester City at Wembley. He has never left the club on loan and committed his long-term future to United in April 2026 by signing a contract running until June 2031. Provided Mainoo suffers no reaction in training, a place on the bench against Chelsea appears the most likely cautious route back into Carrick’s side. Final Thoughts Mainoo returned to team training on Wednesday after missing four matches. The midfielder is now in contention for Saturday’s visit to Chelsea. Featured image Michael Regan via Getty Images online polls

item.title: Just in: Carrick makes decision on returning starter vs Chelsea after face-to-face meeting at Carrington on Tuesday
item.description: Just in: Carrick makes decision on returning starter vs Chelsea after face-to-face meeting at Carrington on Tuesday Michael Carrick and Bruno Fernandes are said to have held a ‘clear-the-air’ meeting together on Tuesday. The pair met face-to-face to discuss their recent conflict, which saw Fernandes openly criticise Carrick and the coaching staff’s tactical decisions for Manchester United’s 4-1 defeat to Como last week. It resulted in the captain being benched for the entirety of Sunday’s loss to Bournemouth, though Carrick insisted Fernandes’ omission was purely a footballing decision. Carrick and Fernandes make amends (Photo by Carl Recine/Getty Images) The Portugal star has gone eight games without registering a goal contribution for United, so you could perhaps believe that Carrick thought it best to leave him out. However, the fact they’ve met one-on-one to hold talks suggests tension did need to be cleared between the pair, especially as talkSPORT claims that the 32-year-old is in line to return to the starting XI for Saturday’s clash with Chelsea. Even amidst his torrid run of form, Fernandes remains United’s most influential player in attack, which has been the case since he joined back in January 2020. Carrick: The state of play (Photo by Dan Istitene/Getty Images) Meanwhile, fans and pundits were expecting Carrick to be relieved of his duties at the start of the week, but INEOS have decided to give him the chance to turn things around. After facing the Blues this weekend, United host AS Roma in the Champions League on Tuesday, November 3, before also welcoming in-form Aston Villa to Old Trafford next Sunday. It’s then the international break, so poor results over the next week-and-a-half could lead to a managerial change when club action hits pause. item.title: John Wall reveals the ‘trigger point’ that led to Jaylen Brown and Jayson Tatum’s beef
item.description: Photo by Jonathan Bachman/Getty Images Jaylen Brown and Jayson Tatum’s relationship falling apart has become one of the biggest talking points of the NBA season. Brown and Tatum were once one of the most formidable duos in the NBA, leading the Boston Celtics to five Eastern Conference Finals, two NBA Finals, and an NBA championship in 2024. However, the last few years have seen their relationship collapse, as their individual rises to superstardom got in the way of their friendship. John Wall says Jayson Tatum’s return from Achilles injury led to friction with Jaylen Brown In an interview with Ashley Nicole Moss of Complex, former NBA All-Star John Wall discussed the issues Jaylen Brown and Jayson Tatum had with each other that led to their partnership collapsing. He believes that Brown getting to experience playing without Tatum, only to be sidelined when Tatum returned, made a huge difference. In particular, Brown no longer getting the distinction of being announced last in the starting lineup when Tatum returned showed him that Tatum will always be considered the superstar. Wall said: “Everybody thought Boston was going to be on a rebuild last year, and the way Jaylen Brown played got them there. Now Tatum comes back, and it’s like, ‘Okay, Tatum’s playing well, but he’s not playing at his All-Star level, MVP level.’ “So now, is Jaylen Brown taking a back seat? Like, even he said, the first game when Tatum came back, Jaylen Brown was getting called out last every game of the season. “Now Tatum’s back, he goes back to second-to-last. It be those little triggering points that make people, like, go against it. I think that’s when Boston started realising, like, somebody got to go, and it ain’t going to be Tatum.” For years, the belief had been that the Celtics value Jayson Tatum more than Jaylen Brown as the main superstar of the franchise. Even after Jaylen Brown won Finals MVP en route to the 2024 NBA Championship, the Celtics seemingly valued Tatum more, with the former Duke standout getting the biggest contract in NBA history at the time, just a year after Brown got a similar deal. Now, Brown and Tatum are rivals in the Eastern Conference, playing for two of the most historic franchises and hoping to get back to the NBA Finals. item.title: 123 Reg discloses 'AI cyberattack' on customer data, suspects China nexus
item.description: UK domain registrar 123 Reg ( no relation – Ed ) says it was the victim of an “AI-driven cyberattack” that exposed customer data. Customers began receiving their notification emails this week, informing them that their contact information, "related customer relationship data," company VAT numbers, and "product information from an application programming interface (API)" were compromised. A company spokesperson elaborated, saying this means that names, phone numbers, countries, language and currency preferences, account creation dates, the products on the account, and marketing preferences were affected. 123 Reg described the September 18 intrusion as "the first known AI-driven cyberattack against our company," and told The Register that early signs point toward a China-nexus attacker. "Our investigation identified IP addresses that we assessed to be the core attacker infrastructure, which were hosted in China and Singapore, indicating a strong Chinese nexus," the spokesperson said. "Our investigation further identified AI cyberattack 'skills' hosted on Chinese infrastructure, including copies of skills open sourced by Anthropic and several other AI exploitation frameworks and scripts." They went on to say that many of the artefacts left behind led 123 Reg to suspect that a Chinese state-sponsored group, known for abusing Claude Code in attacks against at least 30 organizations, could be behind the break-in. There is also a suspicion that the same group that hit a number of South Korea’s financial institutions using open-source Chinese AI tool ARTEX, was behind the attack on 123 Reg too. "The TA's mirror of 'anthropic_skills,' and the account naming conventions found on the Chinese servers are consistent with preparation of this class of AI-augmented operation," the spokesperson told us. "In addition, on October 7, 2026, CrowdStrike published CSA-261162, describing an unknown, likely Chinese-speaking actor that targeted several South Korean financial organizations starting in late September 2026, which is the same period during which we were attacked. "That actor used ARTEX, an open-source Chinese-developed agentic penetration-testing tool released in July 2026, which was also observed to be used in the attack that targeted us." The GoDaddy-owned registrar reported the attack to law enforcement agencies, brought in outside cybersecurity support, and notified the FTC, as well as the data protection authorities in the UK and EU. The company spokesperson added that it worked with Singapore-based ISPs to shut down the attacker's servers in the region, which helped disrupt the attack, in addition to "other actions by us and industry partners." 123 Reg's email to customers stated the attacker's activity "was limited to reading" customer data, although the spokesperson told us "it's possible they created copies of the information," and that this is what prompted the notification. item.title: Ludlow cancels third meeting since summer drought
item.description: Ludlow Racecourse is also home to Ludlow Golf Club [Genevieve Tudor - BBC Radio Shropshire] Ludlow has been forced to cancel a third successive jumps meeting in the 2026-27 season because of the hard ground conditions caused by the summer drought. Grass has died in certain key areas of the course and managing director Simon Sherwood admits that they "are in the lap of the Gods" as to exactly how long the re-seeding process will take as it will need not only rain, but sun too. As one of the best naturally draining racecourses in the country, which normally loses very few meetings during the harsher winter months, it had already been anticipated that Ludlow might not start the season on time. And the first scheduled meeting on 15 October was switched instead to Worcester, 35 miles away. Ludlow also lost the racing scheduled for last week, and has now cancelled the Farmers meeting on 5 November. Their next meeting is now planned for Monday, 23 November. Dry summer puts horse racing season under threat Five big Welsh hopes for the National Hunt season One of the Shropshire track's alternative summer uses is as a weekend Caravan Club site [Ged Scott - BBC Sport] "We're on very much a gravel base at Ludlow Racecourse," Sherwood told BBC Radio Shropshire. "It's a fantastic racecourse when we have a wet winter. People love sending their horses to us as the ground never gets too deep for the horses. "But it can be a bit of a nightmare when we have the other extreme, which obviously we did this summer - the worst since I've been here." Former national hunt racing jockey Sherwood, who rode Desert Orchid to victory in the 1989 Cheltenham Gold Cup, took over as clerk of the course from long-serving Grand National winner Bob Davies in 2019. He said this summer - the driest since 1976 - had been hard to handle. "We had no rain at all in July and the average temperature every day was 31 degrees. "The grass effectively goes to sleep. It went yellow. It goes into a dormant state to survive. Just as it does in people's back gardens at home." Simon Sherwood rode one of British horseracing's most famous horses, Desert Orchard, winning the Cheltenham Gold Cup in 1989 [Shutterstock] He continued: "We don't have the water to keep watering as we have to pull it out of the River Corve to supplement what we can get from the reservoir and, at that time of year, there are restrictions. We had to sit and suffer until the rain came again. "It was not until about September time that the grass started to wake up again. But it became very evident that, in certain parts of the track, some of the grass had actually died - and it became clear that we had an issue with regrowth. And that we needed to reseed." Some of the worst affected areas were on crucial parts of the track, like bends and fences. "Ludlow is quite famous for its tight corners. And we need to guarantee for the jockeys that the grassroots have knitted properly and that there is going to be no risk of slippage," Sherw

item.title: Martin Odegaard calls on Arsenal to 'step up' after Fleetwood humiliation
item.description: Martin Odegaard has warned his Arsenal teammates there is no time for self-pity following a surprise Carabao Cup elimination by Sky Bet League Two outfit Fleetwood on Tuesday evening. A saved penalty from Bruno Guimaraes in the shootout presented teenage defender Conor Haughey with the chance to score the decisive kick, sending the hosts into the quarter-finals in one of the tournament's greatest historic upsets. Mikel Arteta made nine alterations to his side, but despite fielding plenty of international experience, Arsenal produced a disjointed opening period and trailed to Aaron Loupalo-Bi’s 21st-minute strike. The introduction of Norway midfielder Odegaard at half-time dictated play in central midfield and brought a marked improvement, with Viktor Gyokeres soon restoring parity with his first goal of the campaign. Max Dowman received a second yellow for kicking out at a Fleetwood player (PA) The Gunners subsequently squandered several opportunities to take the lead before Max Dowman was sent off in the 85th minute, after which Fleetwood goalkeeper Lynch made two vital saves during injury time to force penalties. "It’s very frustrating to go out," Odegaard said. "Obviously, the way we’ve played was not on the level. We need to do much, much better than we did. "Frustrating, but congratulations to Fleetwood and we look forward to the next game already and bounce back. "They did well so we have to give them credit, but I think (it) was about us not being on our level, we need to do better. I thought we improved during the game, but again, we need to step up even more – so that’s a shame." Arsenal head back to the north west this weekend for a major test against Liverpool at Anfield, where they must clear this disappointment from their system to maintain pressure at the top of the Premier League after drawing level with Manchester City last time out. Bruno Guimaraes missed the crucial penalty that gave Fleetwood the opportunity to send Arsenal ou (PA) "We can’t feel sorry for ourselves," Odegaard added. "We need to move on – we have a big game at the weekend, so bouncing back at the weekend is all we can do now." Arteta won this competition twice while working on Pep Guardiola’s coaching staff at Manchester City, and guided Arsenal to last season's final where they were beaten by City once again. On this occasion, the Arsenal manager conceded defeat gracefully and offered his congratulations to Fleetwood. "That is why football is entertainment, especially in this competition and in this country, things like that" the Spaniard said. "They believe in it and the people have it because of the history. We didn’t want to go through this and we are extremely sad but we need to congratulate the opponent."

item.title: One World Series stat shows why Tampa Bay Rays’ Game 4 win might not be nearly enough
item.description: Photo by Julio Aguilar/Getty Images The Tampa Bay Rays might have just picked up one of the most impressive World Series wins ever, but it may not be enough. Going into the bottom of the 12th inning, the Milwaukee Brewers were only three outs away from winning their first World Series championship. They didn’t manage to get a single one of those outs, though, as the Rays scored two runs to claim a 4-3 victory. The win was incredibly impressive, something which hasn’t been done in the MLB postseason in well over a decade. Tampa Bay became one of a handful of teams to stave off elimination in an extra inning despite being down heading into it. But of all the stats currently being discussed, one should worry them more than any other. No MLB team in history has forced Game 6 in the World Series after going down 3-0 In any sport, everyone knows that going down 3-0 means that the series is more or less over. Baseball has seen it just once, when the Boston Red Sox did it in the ALCS. So despite the fact that their Game 4 win was excellent for morale, the Rays are still facing an incredibly difficult challenge. In fact, there is one historical statistic which shows that they will have to make history to even keep their title hopes alive any further, something which is far easier said than done. “There have been 25 teams in World Series history that have taken a 3 game to 0 lead,” MLB writer Bob Nightengale shared on X. “Only 4 of those teams lost Game 4 to even force a Game 5. No one has forced a Game 6, let alone a Game 7.” That means the Rays would make history even if they can just manage to win again on Wednesday. The Brewers are in a commanding position and it is difficult to see them losing this series. One way or the other, history will be made in Game 5 of the 2026 World Series. item.title: Michael Carrick and Bruno Fernandes 'clear the air' as Man Utd captain set for Chelsea recall
item.description: Michael Carrick and Bruno Fernandes 'clear the air' as Man Utd captain set for Chelsea recall Michael Carrick and Bruno Fernandes have met face-to-face to 'clear the air', with the Manchester United captain now expected to be in contention for Saturday's Premier League trip to Chelsea. Fernandes did not come off the bench for the 3-0 defeat to Bournemouth at Old Trafford, having been dropped after he criticised Carrick's tactics following the 4-1 thrashing at Como in the Champions League. According to Sky Sports News , the pair held an open and frank discussion at United's training ground on Tuesday. It is not known whether Fernandes apologised for his public comments. His criticism of Carrick's approach came just days after Lisandro Martinez had hit out at the club's hierarchy over a lack of investment in the summer transfer window. The one-to-one came alongside an entire squad meeting, where players and staff agreed performances must improve immediately and admitted there had been underperformance across the squad this season. The Red Devils have taken just seven points from their opening eight games of the Premier League campaign. United sit just above the relegation zone after their worst-ever start to a Premier League season, and Carrick's own future has come under scrutiny. A decision has been made for Carrick to continue for this weekend's clash with Chelsea. The 45-year-old was only appointed permanent manager at Old Trafford in the summer. Bruno Fernandes back in contention as Carrick keeps his job for Chelsea showdown On the decision to drop Fernandes, Carrick described his decision to leave out his captain as "pure football". Fernandes is the reigning PFA Player of the Year after breaking the Premier League's single-season assist record (21) in 2025/26. "Picking the team is always a difficult decision," Carrick told Sky Sports. "We've got to make what we feel is the right one for the team to try to get the performance we want."

item.title: "I'll Shave My Head": Ex-Browns Star Ready to Take Drastic Step if Deshaun Watson & Co. Fail to Make Playoffs
item.description: January 13, 2024: Cleveland Browns quarterback Deshaun Watson watches during a Wild Card playoff game between the Cleveland Browns and the Houston Texans in Houston, TX. .. /CSM USA – ZUMAc04_ 20240113_zma_c04_609 Copyright: xTraskxSmithx ©IMAGO/ZUMA Wire Jarvis “Juice” Landry is putting his hair on the line for the Cleveland Browns. Landry said he keeps seeing news outlets and analysts call Cleveland a good team that will still miss the playoffs. His answer was that they are wrong, and he guaranteed the Browns will get in. He even named the penalty he would accept if his prediction proved wrong. “I’m going to say it right here on 4th and South: you’re wrong. Cleveland Browns making the playoffs this year. Guaranteed. If not, I’ll shave my head bald like Lenny here,” Landry said on the podcast. It all started when Fournette asked Landry for his top three teams. Landry went with the Chiefs, the Bills and the Browns. Fournette’s pushback on that last name was simple: one good stretch does not make a top-three team overnight. A former Browns insider is putting his appearance on the line. Subscribe to stay updated on Cleveland's playoff push and the bold predictions shaping the narrative. Landry knows this franchise well after four seasons in Cleveland, where he caught 288 passes for 3,560 yards and 15 touchdowns. This is not the first time Landry has backed the Browns on the show. In June, he laid out his win total picks and sided with Cleveland. That over was listed at +105 at the time. Right now, that pick looks great. Cleveland already has five wins and needs only one more to clear that number. The Browns are also tied with the Steelers atop the AFC North. Fournette had faith earlier than most. Back in April, he picked the Browns to win the division, and Landry went with the Ravens instead. Fournette caught plenty of grief for it at the time. The latest win only helped his case. Cleveland beat the Titans on the road, rallying from a 14-point deficit. Quarterback Deshaun Watson threw for 308 yards, his first 300-yard game as a Brown. Watson then led a fifth-game winning drive in the final minute. Tight end Harold Fannin Jr. made a 36-yard catch, and kicker Andre Szmyt hit a 32-yard field goal on the final play. item.title: Why Angel Reese wraps her leg for every WNBA game
item.description: Photo by Ezra Shaw/Getty Images It’s become one of the most recogniSable looks in basketball, but Angel Reese’s full-leg wrap is far more than a style statement. There were plenty of questions about how Angel Reese’s game would hold up in the Finals, but she answered every single one by putting the Atlanta Dream on her shoulders. When their offense bogged down, it was Reese outworking everyone on the glass and bringing a gritty energy. You can argue about her shooting or the noise that surrounds her, but watching her scrap for every inch proved she’s a true franchise anchor. However, the job is not done, with the Valkyries taking a 3-2 lead in the finals. Angel Reese’s leg strap explained Angel Reese ’s famous single-leg sleeve actually started as a way to hide a painful setback. After breaking her tibia as a freshman at Maryland, surgeons placed a rod in her shinbone through an incision right by her kneecap, leaving behind a lasting scar. “I had surgery two years ago on my shin,” she recalled, later opening up on the I Am Athlete podcast about how her “confidence completely dropped” so badly that she almost walked away from the game. Once she got her groove back, the sleeve stuck around, partly to honor hoop idols like A’ja Wilson and Te’a Cooper who wore the same style, and partly because, as Reese put it best, “It’s swag.” It’s just like Olivia Miles rocking her trademark goggles, every elite hooper finds their own thing, and for Reese, that sleeve is hers. item.title: China take Kylian Mbappé’s apology ‘seriously’, Foreign Affairs Minister says
item.description: China take Kylian Mbappé’s apology ‘seriously’, Foreign Affairs Minister says China’s Foreign Affairs Minister is taking Kylian Mbappé’s (27) apology “seriously”, a spokesperson has said. It comes after the France captain referred to Mao Zedong, the country’s former chairman, as a “dictator” in a clip from The Bridge. The clip, which began circulating late on Monday, when Mbappé was present at the Ballon d’Or ceremony in London, has caused significant backlash in China. Three sponsors have pulled out of their contracts with the Frenchman, whilst there also exists the threat of La Liga games in which he participates not being broadcast in China. That threat elicited a swift response from La Liga, which distanced itself from the remarks, whilst also apologising. Mbappé also made a public apology through his social media platforms soon after. Guo Jiakun, a spokesperson for China’s Foreign Affairs Minister, has responded to the controversy: “We are taking his apology seriously,” he said. The body had initially been highly critical of Mbappé’s comments. On Wednesday, Real Madrid also released their own apology. GFFN | Luke Entwistle

item.title: ‘Only Took 4 Tries,’ ‘This Is Not a Dream’ — NBA World Pokes Fun at Knicks After Defending Champs End Winless Run
item.description: NBA fans had plenty of jokes about New York's slow start, even after the Knicks overcame a 13-point deficit to beat Detroit 111-97 for their first win. The defending champion New York Knicks picked up their first win of the season Tuesday, beating the Detroit Pistons 111-97 after opening their title defense with three straight losses. New York overcame a 13-point first-quarter deficit behind Karl-Anthony Towns, Jalen Brunson, and OG Anunoby. The Knicks have had a less-than-ideal start to their campaign, and fans on social media were quick to joke about how long it took them to win. NBA Fans Troll Knicks After Defending Champions Finally Win New York became the first defending champion to open 0-3 since the 2011-12 Dallas Mavericks. The Knicks fell to the Philadelphia 76ers (106-100), the Boston Celtics (107-103), and the Orlando Magic (111-102) before beating Detroit. Sports enthusiast Jeremy Cohen celebrated the end of the losing streak, writing, “It’s over! It’s over! Knicks fans, this is not a dream! Your long, long wait has ended! Go ahead and cry! After 136 days, the Knicks have finally won an NBA game that counts once again!” Legion Hoops announced the result on X, writing, “JUST IN: The Knicks have won a game. Everyone can quiet down now.” Another fan replied , “Only took 4 tries.” The Knicks’ previous win in a game that counted came in Game 5 of the NBA Finals against the San Antonio Spurs, when they clinched the championship with a 94-90 victory. An Oklahoma City Thunder fan and podcaster also weighed in : “The Knicks and Spurs look like the Knicks and Spurs again.” Another basketball account shared a GIF with the caption, “The NBA Champion Knicks remembering how to play basketball again.” Knicks writer Tommy Beer joked about the team’s familiarity with slow starts: “Knicks down double-digits in the first quarter…. Right where they want to be – get back into the rhythm from the Finals.” New York overcame several large deficits during its championship run, including a 29-point hole in Game 4 and a 16-point deficit in Game 5 against San Antonio. On Tuesday, Detroit led by 13 after the first quarter before the Knicks rallied. SEE ALSO: ‘Jaylen Brown Just Fell to His Knees,’ ‘Kobe Would’ve Been Proud,’ ‘Heck of a PR Team’ – Ex-Celtics Big, NBA Fans React to Jayson Tatum’s Game-Winner Towns recorded a game-high 27 points and grabbed 20 rebounds. Brunson added 23 points but struggled with his shot, going 5-for-18 from the field. Detroit had won its previous six regular-season meetings with New York entering Tuesday’s matchup. The Knicks will look to build on their performance Wednesday night against the Chicago Bulls in the second game of a back-to-back. This article originally appeared on Pro Football Network .

item.title: Ballon d’Or 2026: Harry Kane Makes History As Alexia Putellas Wins Third Award
item.description: Ballon d’Or 2026: Harry Kane Makes History As Alexia Putellas Wins Third Award The historic 70th edition of the Ballon d’Or, the prestigious football awards ceremony presented by France Football, took place in London last night, marking the first time the event had been held outside France or Switzerland. The awards crown the best male and female footballers in the world, but also recognise achievements across several other categories. The Johan Cruyff Trophy, which recognises the Men’s and Women’s Coach of the Year, was picked up by two Spaniards. Pere Romero guided Barcelona’s women’s side to the league title, the Copa del Reina, the Supercopa and the UEFA Champions League. His record with the Barcelona women’s side since joining in 2024 is a staggering one. In 99 matches, he has won 91, drawn three and lost just five, giving him an incredible win percentage of 91.92%. In the men’s game, it was Luis de la Fuente who picked up the award after guiding Spain to their second World Cup title in the United States. De la Fuente also has a staggering record himself, having won several accolades as Spain’s manager, from youth level all the way through to the senior side. The Men’s Club of the Year award was picked up by Paris Saint-Germain, who lifted the Champions League for the second year in a row. After another historic season, they also lifted the Ligue 1 title. The Women’s Club of the Year award went to Barcelona, who, as touched upon earlier, have become an incredibly successful side under the guidance of Romero. The Sócrates Award, which recognises humanitarian work carried out by footballers, was won by Bukayo Saka for his efforts with BigShoe, providing medical care to children who are in desperate need. His speech was particularly powerful, as he read out a letter from one of the boys he had helped. The Gerd Müller Trophy, which recognises the best striker in the men’s and women’s game, was picked up by Harry Kane after an impressive 73 goals in 2026. The women’s award went to Charlyn Corral of Pachuca in Mexico, who had an impressive tally of 49 goals. The Yashin Trophy, which is presented to the best goalkeeper in both the men’s and women’s game, is named after the great Lev Yashin, who remains the only goalkeeper to have won the Ballon d’Or. The women’s award was picked up by Barcelona’s Cata Coll, adding to what was already a staggering evening for the Catalan club. In the men’s game, it was Spaniard Unai Simón who picked up the award after an impressive campaign with Athletic Bilbao, as well as helping guide Spain to World Cup glory. The Kopa Trophy, which recognises the best under-21 player in the game, saw Vicky López add another award to Barcelona’s growing collection in the women’s game, while Lamine Yamal picked up the trophy in the men’s category. item.title: Why did Fleetwood have to lose player for Arsenal penalty shootout?
item.description: Fleetwood Town were forced to drop down to 10 men for their EFL Cup penalty shootout against Arsenal on Tuesday [Getty Images] Fleetwood Town were forced to surrender a player for their penalty shootout win over Arsenal at Highbury on Tuesday night. The Fishermen beat the Gunners 5-3 on penalties to book their place in the EFL Cup quarter-finals for the first time in the club's history. But as the two sides entered the shootout following a 1-1 draw in 90 minutes, the hosts were forced to elect a player to sit out. This is because teams are forced to play penalty shootouts with the same number of players involved on either side. Arsenal ended the match with 10 men after teenager Max Dowman was shown a red card in the second half. Law 10.3 of the International Football Association Board's laws of the game states that "if at the end of the match and before or during the kicks one team has a greater number of players than its opponents, it must reduce its numbers to the same number as its opponents and the referee must be informed of the name and number of each player excluded. Any excluded player is not eligible to take part in the kicks". This includes goalkeepers defending the penalties. Fleetwood named defender Jake Batty as the player to miss out on taking part in the shootout so the two sides were even. "Fleetwood have to nominate a player to not take a penalty and that is Jake Batty because of Dowman's sending off, so it becomes 10 against 10," Sky Sports commentator Peter Drury explained at the time. This article is the latest from BBC Sport's Ask Me Anything team. More questions answered... When is the EFL Cup quarter-final draw? Which game will Chelsea's Palmer miss after red card? item.title: Yet another DNF for Cadillac’s Valtteri Bottas: ‘Sometimes we don’t quite understand it’
item.description: Motorsport photo Valtteri Bottas described the Cadillac Formula 1 team as struggling to understand its issues, after he retired from Sunday’s United States Grand Prix. Bottas suffered his ninth retirement of the season at the Circuit of The Americas, a surprisingly high number for a driver whose pre-2026 DNF rate was 11%. Of those nine, eight were linked to technical problems, and that was the case again with a suspected power-unit issue in Austin. “It's always disappointing not to finish, but it didn't sound great from the engine side, like physically,” the Finn commented. Read Also: Valtteri Bottas denies he might lose his Cadillac seat for F1 2027 Cadillac still needs to iron out its gremlins, in terms of both reliability and performance, but this may not occur until next year’s challenger takes to the track. “I would say it's impossible to get a read on a year like this with so many issues,” Bottas added. “And the problem is sometimes we don't quite understand them. So it's really still a steep learning curve to go. “There's been lots of things in the background that maybe not everyone sees, like the brake management, the amount of having to deal with that and all these things. But at the same time, like I said, sometimes there's been some issues that we're struggling to see.” Valtteri Bottas, Cadillac Racing Valtteri Bottas, Cadillac Racing Still, both cars briefly mingled with the Aston Martins and Williams in the Austin race, though they eventually fell adrift. Perez finished the race some 20 seconds behind Fernando Alonso , Alexander Albon and Carlos Sainz , which actually was a marked improvement; Bottas was just five seconds shy of his team-mate when he retired. “It was at times quite positive to see that we were pretty close to some other cars on pace,” Bottas said, while Perez felt hindered by his strategy. “Unfortunately I think with the timing of the blue flags we lost a lot of race time, because as we pitted we basically went straight into the blue flags,” the Mexican claimed. Data shows he was lapped on lap 28 after pitting on lap 23. As for why Cadillac was more competitive than usual in Texas, the pair had different theories. “I think it's very, very track-dependent,” Perez reckoned. “In the race I was surprised that we were a bit closer in that regard.” “I think today what helped was the cloud cover,” Bottas pointed out. “It was a bit cooler today, we know we are not great when it's high temperatures, so that helped a bit. But I thought it was going to be more difficult for us here, honestly. So that's why it's kind of positive, and Mexico should be hopefully a bit better for us.” While Cadillac won’t be hindered by its lack of downforce to the same extent at Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez, warm temperatures – some 26C ambient – and sunshine are currently forecast for both qualifying and the race. item.title: Lamine Yamal breaks silence after losing Ballon d’Or; Father reportedly involved in violent airport incident
item.description: Lamine Yamal breaks silence after losing Ballon d’Or; Father reportedly involved in violent airport incident appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . After a successful 2025-26 LaLiga season and a 2026 FIFA World Cup campaign, Spain’s Lamine Yamal was a heavy favorite to win this year’s Ballon d’Or . However, an even better performance from England captain Harry Kane in the Bundesliga, German domestic tournaments, and the World Cup made sure he took the trophy home. Now, FC Barcelona’s Yamal has finally broken his silence after missing out on the 2026 Ballon d’Or award to Kane. While 33-year-old Kane celebrated, the likes of Yamal and Kylian Mbappé were left disappointed despite their strong chances. However, Yamal won the Kopa Trophy, which is handed out to the best young talent of the year. Later on Instagram, the youngster addressed the loss and uploaded a series of pictures. “IT WILL COME, good things take time, I trust the path I’m building. Without a hurry, with excitement and with tranquility that someday my time will come. Congratulations to the winners, my focus is again on what’s important, to make FC Barcelona win again,” Yamal wrote. (quotes translated by Instagram) Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) View this post on Instagram However, while Yamal celebrated a successful night in London, UK, his father faced a rather unfortunate incident while flying out of Spain. Lamine Yamal’s father goes viral for violent airport incident According to Spanish news outlet El Espanyol, Yamal’s father, Mounir Nasraoui, was involved in a violent incident at Barcelona Airport in Barcelona ahead of flying out to London for his son’s Ballon d’Or award ceremony. It was reported that Nasraoui placed his jacket in a place where it was not permitted. This led to the airport staff asking him to remove it. However, the discussion soon escalated, and the video posted by El Espanyol claimed that Nasraoui spat in the direction of the waitress. It was also reported that after a bystander tried to intervene, Yamal’s father allegedly grabbed a chair and threw it towards the man. In the end, the local police got involved and resolved the matter. Jake Hager has another eye surgery following scary Power Slap TKO: ‘Send prayers’
item.description: LAS VEGAS, NEVADA - JULY 08: Jake Hager (L) and Patrica Blackurn attend the 17th annual Fighters Only World MMA Awards at Sahara Las Vegas on July 08, 2026 in Las Vegas, Nevada. (Photo by Ethan Miller/Getty Images) | Getty Images Former WWE wrestler and Bellator fighter turned Power Slap contestant Jake Hager (also known by his wrasslin’ name Jack Swagger) is still suffering from a scary eye injury sustained during a Power Slap event back in September. Hager made headlines when he signed with UFC CEO Dana White’s pet project Power Slap back in April 2026, winning his first slap fight via KO in round three. His next two bouts did not go as well: he was KO’d in July, and then suffered a horrific injury at Power Slap 23 in September that saw blood and fluid start leaking out his eye. Hager underwent emergency eye surgery that night but is still having issues two months later according to an update from his fiance Patricia. Amanpreet Singh (Mahabali Shera in TNA) knocked Jake Hager out on Power Slap! pic.twitter.com/voBYhTiu3S — Fightful Wrestling (@Fightful) July 11, 2026 “It was discovered this week that Jake had a detached retina,” Instagram account Slap News reported. “He underwent surgery to reattach, which doctors have said went better than expected. Send your love and prayers to Jake and Patricia as they navigate a very sensitive and unpredictable recovery.” “I want to thank the UFC and Power Slap for their support and assistance,” Patricia added in the comments. “I’m also deeply grateful to his medical team and everyone who has reached out, prayed, and shown Jake so much love.” Power Slap continues to roll along despite being one of the most disgusting ‘sports’ we’ve ever witnessed. Can you really call it a sport when it’s one person standing prone while another gets a free shot at their face? While the show didn’t pull enough numbers to stay on television for more than a few weeks, owner Dana White insists it generates more views and follows than many major sports leagues and even beats out Taylor Swift. Whether that’s true or smoke and mirrors, it seems like there’s news of a new Power Slap deal every other week, from Power Slap signing a residency deal with MGM Resorts to Power Slap piggy-backing off TKO and showing up in cities alongside UFC events. Jake Hager isn’t the first Power Slap contestant to deal with a serious injury from the event, just the best known. And we doubt he’ll be the last.

item.title: Liverpool vs Chelsea prediction: Carabao Cup betting tips and best odds
item.description: Liverpool vs Chelsea betting tips: BTTS and Liverpool to win - 23/10 Betway Koumas to score at any time - 19/10 Ladbrokes Xabi Alonso returns to Anfield tonight when he takes his Chelsea side up north for a Carabao Cup last-16 clash (kick-off 8pm, live on Sky Sports). The Spaniard spent five years playing for Liverpool, winning the Champions League back in 2005, but tonight is all about his side bouncing back from their shock defeat at home to Tottenham Hotspur at the weekend. Saturday’s 2-0 defeat was only Spurs’ second win at Stamford Bridge in 36 years, and maybe more worrying for Alonso was the form of goalkeeper Mike Penders, who struggled on his first Premier League start. The youngster replaced the injured Emi Martinez and punched the ball into his own net to give the visitors the lead in the 77th minute. Cole Palmer, who seemed to let his frustration boil over, then saw red for two yellow cards, and Mathys Tel made sure of the win with his first goal of the season. That defeat was their third of the season and saw them slip to fifth in the Premier League table, replaced in the top four by Liverpool following their impressive 2-0 win over Brighton. The Blues have so far beaten Luton Town and Leeds United to set up this tie, while Andoni Iraola’s side have played just once due to their involvement in European competition. They beat Spurs 3-1 at Anfield and will be looking to keep alive their hopes of winning the competition for a record 11th time, and football betting sites have them as the second favourites to lift the trophy in March, just behind Manchester City, at odds of 3/1. The competition has certainly opened up following League Two Fleetwood Town’s shock win over Premier League champions Arsenal, and this competition could give Chelsea the chance to claim their first domestic silverware since 2018. They have won this competition five times but were beaten in both the 2022 and 2024 finals by tonight’s opponents. Liverpool vs Chelsea tips: Reds to shade it This will be the 11th meeting between the two sides in this competition, and the last two of those came in the finals mentioned. Neither could be described as a classic encounter, though, with the Reds winning the first 11-10 on penalties after a goalless 120 minutes at Wembley. The 2024 final looked to be heading in the same direction until Virgil van Dijk scored the only goal of the game after 118 minutes, so hopefully tonight’s meeting will be more entertaining. In the league, both teams have scored in their last six meetings, and you have to go back to 2021 since Chelsea last won at Anfield, when Mason Mount scored the only goal of the game just before the break. They also won their last meeting on Merseyside in this competition back in 2018 when goals by Emerson and Eden Hazard cancelled out Daniel Sturridge’s opener. We expect a lot of changes to the starting lineups for this one, especially with Liverpool facing Arsenal in the league this weekend before travelling to Turkey

item.title: Indiana center Bray Lynch on Josh Hoover’s play, toughness: ‘He’s a dog like that’
item.description: ANN ARBOR, MICHIGAN - OCTOBER 24: Josh Hoover #10 of the Indiana Hoosiers plays against the Michigan Wolverines at Michigan Stadium on October 24, 2026 in Ann Arbor, Michigan. (Photo by Gregory Shamus/Getty Images) | Getty Images Indiana quarterback Josh Hoover made an impression on his teammates the moment he arrived in Bloomington this past offseason. Just ask Bray Lynch, the center he’s taken snaps from all season. Lynch said he was unsurprised by Hoover’s drive to play through an arm injury against Ohio State and Michigan, saying that if he’d been asked back in the preseason if Hoover would do such a thing his response would be a simple “hell yeah.” “He’s a dog like that,” Lynch said. “You saw it in spring ball, you see it in the weight room and you see it now on Saturdays.” Hoover’s shown his toughness multiple times throughout the season, staying in for the Hoosiers’ season opener against North Texas despite blood pouring down his face from a nose injury he suffered after his facemask was grabbed. He’s even ran in to try and throw a few blocks for Turbo Richard and Lee Beebe Jr. during critical runs, namely against Northwestern. Then came the Michigan game when Hoover battled through the aforementioned injury, ultimately delivering in overtime with a pass to tight end Brock Schott before diving into the endzone himself for the go ahead touchdown that ended up winning the day. One thing that’s clear about Hoover is this: he’s more than earned the trust and respect of his teammates despite this being his first and only season in Bloomington. They’re willing to fight for him in the same way he is for them. “We have full confidence in him,” Lynch said. “We knew that when the time arose to make a play, he was gonna find a way to get it done.” Join the conversation! item.title: Arkansas Razorbacks Preview
item.description: NASHVILLE, TENNESSEE - OCTOBER 17: Head Coach Ryan Silverfield of the Arkansas Razorbacks celebrates beating the Vanderbilt Commodores at FirstBank Stadium on October 17, 2026 in Nashville, Tennessee. (Photo by Carly Mackler/Getty Images) | Getty Images Welcome to the last “you really should win this no matter what” game of the year. You don’t get a lot of those in a college football season. Yes, your various FCS opponents carry that tag. And, yes, probably the G6 school that you agreed to terms with 10 years ago while crossing your fingers that they still suck when the bill comes due. But there are very few of those in conference play, especially in the SEC. Thankfully, OUR MOST HATED RIVAL SPONSERED BY AN INSURANCE COMPANY falls into that category. The Texas games continues to trend to more of a coin flip as the season goes on. Same for Oklahoma (yay!) and Kentucky (boo!). And while Georgia will always remain a snow-ball-in-hell levels of victory, Arkansas has stayed fairly consistently in “Mizzou is going to win big” territory. Want to know why? I bet you do! Let’s walk through it. When Missouri Has the Ball With the 85th-ranked defense in SP+, Arkansas doesn’t have a lot that they can be proud of here. 105th in overall success rate allowed, 108th against the run, 92nd against the pass, 117th in havoc, 133rd in points allowed per scoring opportunity. Yes sir, all the signs here point to a Missouri offense renaissance of points, efficiency, and explosiveness. Of course, the signs were there for the Ole Miss game, too. NEVER MIND THAT. MOVING ON. Generate Explosives This is what Missouri does to move the ball and Arkansas (on paper) is more than happy to allow it. Of course, Mizzou might wind up being more efficient that explosive on accident – Arkansas is very generous in allowing yards of all types – but we’ll keep this goal consistent. Let’s see 10 explosive plays generated . Convert Third Downs Once defenders started realizing that Cayden Lee was the one guy that Austin Simmons looked to on 3rd-downs, the conversions have begun to get less frequent. With the caveat that I’d like to see a continuation of Donovan Olugbode’s conversion abilities (or anyone else), let’s shoot for at least a 60% success rate on 3rd-down . Finish Your Dang Drives Mizzou sucks at this on offense. Arkansas sucks at this on defense. Something has to give! Ideally it’s the Hogs and we can see that Mizzou averaged at least 5 points per scoring opportunity . When Arkansas Has the Ball Arkansas’ 60th-ranked offense is not even the strength of this team – that would be the 50th-ranked special teams – but it at least has something it can do moderately well. Not run the ball, though (99th). Or finish drives with points (123rd). Or succeed in passing downs (101st). No, the Hogs mostly succeed on standard downs (44th) by throwing the ball at a 44.4% success rate (56th). They also rank 49th in 3rd-down conversions. And that’s the end of the list of things they do that don’t ra

item.title: “Get Rid of It All”: Steelers Veteran Cam Heyward Calls for Double NFL Rule Changes Before Browns Game
item.description: Copyright: xPhilipxG.xPavelyx 20231102_pmo_pa4_106 ©IMAGO/USA TODAY Network Pittsburgh Steelers defensive tackle Cam Heyward has seen almost everything in the NFL in his tenured career. However, in all these years, he seems to have developed hatred for one move that is mutually understood and respected by all teams. “No more kneel downs,” Heyward declared, stating his demands during his appearance on The Rich Eisen Show , ahead of the Week 8 game against the Cleveland Browns . “Get them out of the game. It’s not a football play.” But that boggled Eisen’s mind. Kneeling at the end of the game to allow the quarterbacks to safely run down the remaining time on the clock without really risking anything. Instead of playing it safe, Heyward wanted to run a traditional play. He didn’t want any part of the victory formation. “Get rid of that. Get rid of it all,” Heyward further added. “Just make sure it’s an active play that both teams are trying to win.” Cam Heyward isn't holding back on what the NFL needs to fix. Subscribe to stay ahead of the rule debates shaping the league's biggest rivalries. Heyward also said no to spiking the ball to manage time, surprising Eisen one more time. When prompted about how else the opposing offense gets to stop the clock, Heyward said, “throw it out of bounds.” Of course, the Steelers defensive tackle hasn’t run his thoughts down with Aaron Rodgers. Heyward knows better than to actively pursue the matter. “He’s going to kill me for it,” Heyward said when Eisen asked him if he had discussed his takes on kneeling and spiking with Rodgers. “Asking a defensive lineman, I want no more kneel downs,” he added. “I want this to be, a play is a play. It’s always gotta count. It’s always gotta be something going forward instead of just kneeling the ball down and calling it a game.” Rodgers kneeled twice against the New Orleans Saints in Paris to bring home a much-needed victory for Pittsburgh. Before that, he knelt in the final few seconds of regulation to keep things safe against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers, who lost the game in overtime. Taking away such a move from Rodgers is definitely going to earn the intended individual wrath from him, and pretty much every quarterback in the league. There has been one individual who has dared to put Heyward’s intention to practice. Greg Schiano, when he was the head coach of the Tampa Bay Buccaneers, infamously bull-rushed through a victory formation of the New York Giants in 2012. Quarterback Eli Manning, who was hoping to bring home after a great performance (510 passing yards and three touchdowns), found himself on his back after a kneel-down attempt. “I don’t think you do that at this level,” then head coach Tom Coughlin said after the game. “You jeopardize the O-line, you jeopardize the quarterback. Thank goodness we didn’t get anybody hurt — that I know of. A couple of linemen were late coming in.” “What I do with our football team is we fight until they tell us ‘game over,'” Schiano s

item.title: 'I promise': Mikel Brown Jr. has a message for Nets fans after going from hero to zero vs Celtics
item.description: Photo by Dustin Satloff/Getty Images Mikel Brown Jr. must have experienced a rollercoaster of emotions during the Brooklyn Nets’ heartbreaking defeat against the Boston Celtics. The 20-year-old is in his rookie season in the NBA, and his performances so far have shown that there is a lot to like about his game. Against the Boston Celtics, Brown became the hero at the end of regulation time, but everything came crashing down in the final moments of the game. Mikel Brown Jr. makes a promise to Brooklyn Nets fans after losing to Boston Celtics The game between the Brooklyn Nets and the Boston Celtics was an absolute thriller. The Nets were losing at the end of regulation time, but Brown pulled off a clutch three-pointer with 0.2 seconds left on the clock to send the game to overtime. The rookie was the hero in that moment, but the tables turned at the end of overtime, as his mistakes cost the Nets the win. Brown missed two layups in the final six seconds of the game, when his side were leading. Instead of slowing the game down and drawing an intentional foul, he drove into traffic and missed a contested layup over Paul George. The Celtics secured the rebound and called a timeout. Then, in the final action of the game, Jayson Tatum scored at the buzzer to win it. That became a hero-to-zero moment in a short space of time for young Brown, but he showed extreme maturity after the game by taking accountability for his actions. He tweeted : “That one is on me, Brooklyn! I’m going to shake back. I promise y’all that.” Even in his post-match interviews, Brown put the blame on himself and admitted that his decision-making should’ve been better. He said, as per Brian Lewis of the New York Post on X : “It’s a broken play. I blame me. “We weren’t supposed to switch that and I switched it. Made a couple of mistakes down the stretch that hurt us. So I’m going to take the blame for it, learn from it and get prepared for the next game.” Such accountability from such a young man is great to see. We’re sure Brown will learn from his mistakes and bounce back in the coming games. item.title: The Sheffield United Dilemma Chris Wilder Surely Can’t Ignore
item.description: The Sheffield United Dilemma Chris Wilder Surely Can’t Ignore When Romelle Donovan arrived at Sheffield United on loan from Brentford during the summer transfer window, there was genuine excitement surrounding the 19-year-old winger. The young Englishman had shown enough promise to suggest that he could become an exciting addition to Chris Wilder’s squad, but he also arrived with a considerable challenge ahead of him. Donovan was tasked with filling the void left by boyhood Blade Andre Brooks, who departed Bramall Lane to join Norwich City. Replacing a homegrown talent who had developed a connection with the supporters was never going to be straightforward, but the Brentford youngster appeared to possess the attributes to make his own mark in S2. His pre-season performances offered plenty of encouragement, and he showed further glimpses of his potential during the opening weeks of the campaign. Yet, as the season has progressed, Donovan has found himself spending far more time watching from the sidelines than making a meaningful contribution on the pitch. And that is becoming increasingly difficult for Sheffield United supporters to understand. Only Wilder knows precisely why the teenager has been overlooked so frequently, but the decision to leave him out of the starting eleven has become a frustrating talking point among the Blades faithful. With United struggling to find consistency and a reliable attacking threat, the continued absence of a player who appears capable of injecting some much-needed energy into the side is raising legitimate questions. Donovan Offers Something Sheffield United Are Desperately Missing SHEFFIELD, ENGLAND – OCTOBER 24: Romelle Donovan of Sheffield United runs with the ball during the Sky Bet Championship 2026/27 match between Sheffield United and Derby County at Bramall Lane on October 24, 2026 in Sheffield, England.
